_doc: area = [u0, v0, u1, v1] em frações de Entrada-expandida.png onde a ação acontece (o script expande para uma proporção aceita pelo modelo e salva o retângulo em pixels em work/state.json). Janela visível no desktop 16:9: u 0.245–0.833, v 0.334–0.828; ultrawide corta abaixo de v 0.682. 'order' define a ordem de pintura (fundo -> frente) e a ordem em que as placas são tiradas da composição acumulada. frames[0] é gerado a partir da placa; os demais são edições do frame A. hold = [min, max] em ms que o frame fica parado.

vignettes.who: three small distant guild members leaning on the wooden balcony railing of the middle gallery: a wizard in a blue pointed hat, a bard holding a lute and a hooded rogue
vignettes.doing: standing BEHIND the wooden balcony railing of the middle gallery, chatting and looking down at the hall. They are on the far side of the railing: the horizontal rail and every vertical baluster must be drawn OVER their bodies, so only their heads, shoulders and forearms resting on the top rail are visible above it, and their bodies are only glimpsed through the gaps between the balusters

frames.name: b
frames.change: the bard strums the lute and the wizard turns his head toward the bard

frames.name: c
frames.change: the hooded rogue leans forward over the railing and points down at the hall, the wizard looks where he points
tweens: the hooded rogue starts leaning forward over the railing, his arm half raised, not pointing yet; the wizard still looks ahead
the hooded rogue leans further over the railing and his arm lowers to point down toward the hall, almost fully pointing; the wizard begins to look where he points

vignettes.who: a young half-elf bard in a wine-red doublet and feathered cap
vignettes.doing: sitting sideways on one of the lower steps of the wooden staircase, playing a lute, one foot on the step below

frames.name: b
frames.change: the strumming hand moves down across the strings and the head tilts slightly with the music

frames.name: c
frames.change: the strumming hand moves up again and the bard taps the foot

frames.name: d
frames.change: he looks up toward the balcony above with a broad smile while his fingers keep playing the lute
tweens: he starts lifting his head toward the balcony above, chin raised halfway, a small smile appearing; his fingers keep playing
he lifts his head a bit more, almost looking straight up at the balcony, his smile widening; his fingers keep playing

vignettes.who: two adventurers: a human ranger woman in a green hooded cloak and a bald bearded human warrior
vignettes.doing: sitting on the benches on both sides of the left long wooden table, leaning over a parchment map spread on the table, planning a route; the ranger points at the map

frames.name: b
frames.change: the warrior points at another spot of the map and the ranger looks up at him
tweens: the warrior's hand starts sliding across the map toward another spot, arm half extended; the ranger starts lifting her head, eyes moving up
the warrior's arm extends further across the map, his finger almost touching the new spot; the ranger's head is raised, looking up at him

frames.name: c
frames.change: the warrior leans back and crosses his arms while the ranger keeps tracing the route on the map
tweens: the warrior starts leaning back from the table, hands lifting off the map toward his chest; the ranger keeps tracing the route
the warrior leans back further, his forearms starting to cross over his chest but not fully crossed yet; the ranger keeps tracing the route

frames.name: d
frames.change: both laugh together, the ranger covering her smile with one hand
tweens: both start smiling, the warrior's mouth opening into a grin; the ranger's free hand starts rising toward her mouth, at chest height
both laugh a bit more: the warrior grins widely and the ranger's hand is now just below her mouth

vignettes.tooltip: 🗺️ Traçando a rota do próximo contrato

vignettes.who: four adventurers: a red-bearded dwarf, a blonde elf archer, a young human knight without helmet and an old gnome with a pointed hat
vignettes.doing: sitting on the benches around the right long table next to the fireplace, chatting and holding wooden mugs of mead

frames.name: b
frames.change: all of them raise their mugs together over the table in a toast
tweens: all of them start lifting their mugs off the table: every mug is about a hand's height above the table, not yet raised high
all the mugs rise higher, now at shoulder height and moving toward the middle of the table, but not touching yet

frames.name: c
frames.change: the red-bearded dwarf leans back laughing loudly with his head thrown back, the others smile at him
tweens: the red-bearded dwarf starts leaning back with a wide grin, head tilted back only halfway, mouth opening to laugh; the others start smiling
the red-bearded dwarf leans back a bit more, head tilted further back, mouth open wider laughing; the others smile

frames.name: d
frames.change: the blonde elf drinks from her mug while the knight tells a story gesturing with his free hand
tweens: the blonde elf lifts her mug toward her mouth, mug at chin height; the knight raises his free hand halfway, starting to gesture
the blonde elf's mug is now almost at her lips; the knight's free hand is raised a bit higher, gesturing as he talks

foreground._why: cavaleiro e gnomo ficam na frente da chama animada da lareira (GuildVfxLayer)

vignettes.doing: sleeping curled up on the warm stone hearth in front of the fireplace

frames.name: b
frames.change: the cat's tail tip is lifted and curled and one ear twitches
tweens: the cat's tail tip starts lifting slightly and one ear tilts a little
the cat's tail tip rises a bit higher and starts to curl; the ear twitches

frames.name: c
frames.change: the cat lifts its head and yawns widely, eyes closed, still lying curled
tweens: the cat lifts its head slightly and its mouth starts to open in a small yawn, eyes half closed
the cat lifts its head a bit more and opens its mouth wider in a yawn, eyes closed

vignettes.tooltip: 🐈 Brasa, o gato oficial da guilda

vignettes.who: a plump middle-aged human woman, the guild receptionist, grey-streaked auburn hair in a bun, round spectacles, dark green dress with a leather apron
vignettes.doing: standing BEHIND the back wooden counter (the counter hides her from the waist down), writing in a big ledger with a quill

frames.name: b
frames.change: she lifts her head and the quill and smiles toward the hall entrance
tweens: she starts lifting her head and the quill: her head is raised halfway and the quill is lifted just above the page, a small smile appearing
she raises her head a bit more and lifts the quill higher, her smile widening as she looks toward the hall entrance

frames.name: c
frames.change: she turns a page of the big ledger with her free hand, the quill raised in the other hand
tweens: her free hand moves to the edge of the ledger page and starts lifting the page corner; the quill starts rising in the other hand
her free hand lifts the page higher, the page now standing up halfway through being turned; the quill is raised in the other hand

frames.name: d
frames.change: she pushes her round spectacles up her nose with one finger and looks down at the ledger
tweens: she starts raising one hand toward her face: her finger is at chin height, not yet touching the spectacles
her finger now reaches the bridge of her round spectacles, starting to push them up

vignettes.who: an old elf scholar in deep blue robes with a long white braid
vignettes.doing: sitting in the red armchair inside the library room, reading a thick open book under the lantern light

frames.name: b
frames.change: the scholar turns a page of the book with one hand
tweens: the scholar's hand moves to the edge of the right page and starts lifting the page corner
the scholar's hand lifts the page higher, the page standing up halfway through being turned

frames.name: c
frames.change: the scholar lowers the open book onto his lap with both hands and raises his whole head to look straight ahead toward the viewer, eyebrows raised in curiosity, mouth slightly open

vignettes.tooltip: 📚 O arquivista nunca sai da biblioteca

vignettes.who: a tall green-skinned orc warrior with a big axe strapped to his back and a short halfling rogue in a brown hood
vignettes.doing: standing with their backs to the viewer in front of the contracts board inside the left arch, reading the posted contracts

frames.name: b
frames.change: the orc raises one arm and points at a contract high on the board while the halfling stands on tiptoe
tweens: the orc starts raising one arm toward the board, the arm at shoulder height, not pointing high yet; the halfling starts rising on his toes
the orc's arm rises higher, now above his head, almost pointing at the contract; the halfling is on tiptoe

frames.name: c
frames.change: the halfling points at a lower contract on the board and the orc tilts his head down to look at it
tweens: the halfling starts raising his arm toward a lower contract, arm halfway up; the orc starts tilting his head down
the halfling's arm extends further toward the lower contract, almost pointing at it; the orc tilts his head down a bit more

frames.name: d
frames.change: the orc crosses his big arms over his chest, thinking, while the halfling scratches his chin
tweens: the orc starts folding his arms, both forearms moving toward his chest but not crossed yet; the halfling's hand starts rising toward his chin
the orc's forearms now overlap in front of his chest, almost crossed; the halfling's hand reaches his chin

vignettes.who: Gloin, a stocky red-bearded dwarf warrior with a braided beard, iron pauldrons and brown leather armor
vignettes.doing: sitting on the small wooden crate next to the barrel, legs apart, holding a big wooden mug of mead resting on his knee

frames.name: b
frames.change: he raises the mug to his mouth and drinks

rig.remove: his whole right arm below the shoulder armor (on the LEFT side of the image): the upper arm, the elbow, the forearm, the bracer, the hand and the wooden mug it holds. Paint what was hidden behind it: the side of his torso and brown leather tunic, his belt with its square metal buckle, his thigh and knee, and the stone wall behind him.

frames.name: c
frames.change: he wipes the beer foam from his moustache with the back of his free hand, eyes closed with satisfaction

rig.remove: his whole left arm below the shoulder armor (on the RIGHT side of the image, near the barrel): the upper arm, the forearm and the hand resting on his knee. Paint what was hidden behind it: the side of his brown leather tunic and belt, his thigh and knee, and the wooden barrel behind him.

walkers.who: a weary adult human traveler, life-size, with a big backpack with a rolled bedroll on top and a dusty hooded brown cloak, hands free (no staff)

cycle.name: a
cycle.pose: CONTACT: right leg stepping forward with the heel touching the floor, left leg straight behind on its toes, left arm swinging forward and right arm back

cycle.name: b
cycle.pose: PASSING: right leg planted straight under the body carrying the weight, left leg bent and passing next to it with the foot lifted, arms close to the body

cycle.name: c
cycle.pose: CONTACT (mirror of the first step): LEFT leg stepping forward with the heel touching the floor, right leg straight behind on its toes, right arm swinging forward and left arm back

cycle.name: d
cycle.pose: PASSING (mirror): LEFT leg planted straight under the body carrying the weight, right leg bent and passing next to it with the foot lifted, arms close to the body

route._doc: pontos em fracoes da imagem (pes); horizon = v onde a altura de uma pessoa tende a zero (perspectiva do piso)

behaviour._doc: ms; stepLength = fracao da altura do corpo percorrida por passo (meio ciclo)

walkers.tooltip: 🎒 Um viajante acabou de chegar à guilda
